title: Visual window error and crash
body: ### Tested versions In version: Godot_v4.7-stable_win64 ### System information Windows 11 - Godot Engine v4.7.stable.official.5b4e0cb0f - OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 595.79 - Compatibility - Using Device: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 ### Issue description I note that the application opens correctly; the bug can occur by opening any additional window other than the main Godot window. The bug consists of a window flashing while rapidly moving from one point on the screen to another.
